locator: section 4.5.2; PDF p. 7 / proceedings p. 11999; paragraph beginning “However, some other cases show...”
proposition: Cantonese 有 can combine productively with 得; the 有-得 cluster indicates possibility of the event denoted by the following verb, while negative 冇-得 indicates unavailability or impossibility.
limitation: The paper is a word-segmentation study. It does not supply a full syntactic analysis, a complete semantic taxonomy, productivity boundaries, subject structure, or an analysis of 有冇得 questions.

proposition: An overt 有冇 interrogative can function as an embedded indirect question; the paper treats such A-not-A/disjunctive questions as information-seeking.
limitation: The example is 有冇 + experiential predicate, not 有冇得. It supports embedded suppletive 有冇 question structure generally, not the availability construction specifically.
